option_relations.rationale: Atrial tachycardia can be a subtype of various tachycardia disorders, including atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia
Atypical Atrioventricular Nodal Reentrant Tachycardia (Atypical AVNRT) is a specific type of atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia
Focal atrial tachycardia can be related to atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia, but it is not a direct match
AV nodal reentrant tachycardia is a broader term that includes atypical AVNRT
